_comment: The Fortune deck (Dial 1 — the feast/famine master dial). A FIXED composition of 54 cards (incl. 3 code-violation defects) drawn WITHOUT reshuffle until exhausted, so a run of shocks becomes a real 'season' players can roughly card-count. Mix: jobs 20 — half (10) require equipment to START (so early rounds favour the small ungated jobs until you tool up); big jobs also need a bigger shop (required_building_tier 2 = Shop+, 3 = Warehouse); the Office-tower fit-out is the endgame combo (tier-3 shop + a tool per worker + 3-crew, long deadline, big payout). About HALF of the 20 job copies are trade-specific (required_trade, covering all six services) so in a full table they route player-to-player — the AR/AP web; the rest are general bread-and-butter anyone can do for early cash. windfalls 14 and shocks 6 — of which a count-scaling set tilts the equipment-vs-hire choice (Dial 3): equipment is rewarded net-positive (patent ×2 + efficiency award ×2 give per_equipment cash; depreciation audit ×1 penalises it) while headcount is penalised net (birthday gives a small per_tradesman bonus; profit-share penalises per_tradesman and a retirement churns a worker); payables 4 (NPC vendor bills → the AP float game); gifts 4 (deal a Civil hand card); summons 2 (draw a Civil event); retirement 1. Shocks + payables keep shops desperate; windfalls bolster cash flow. `per_equipment`/`per_tradesman` scale a card's cash by your build. A `forced` job routes a deposit from a client player to the contractor; abandoning it lets the client sue. The `flavor` field is pure immersion (Maple Hollow rivalries) and has no mechanical effect. `copies` is expanded by the loader.

cards.name: Re-pipe the old creamery
cards.flavor: You land the creamery contract — but it's all pipe. Sub it to the plumber, bill the owner your markup, and pray they don't botch it.

cards.name: Strip-mall HVAC retrofit
cards.flavor: The strip-mall owner signs with you. The rooftop units are an HVAC job — sub it out, mark it up, carry the receivable till they pay.

cards.name: Rewire the Odd Fellows hall
cards.flavor: The lodge wants its hall rewired. You're no sparky — broker it to the electrician and take the spread.

cards.name: Restore the Town Hall
cards.flavor: The Mayor wants the Town Hall restored before the centennial. Land it and the whole council owes you favours — let it collapse and the town raises everyone's levy to cover it.

cards.name: Raise the new firehouse
cards.flavor: The town's been promised a firehouse for years. Finish it and you're a hero with favours to spare — botch it and every shop's insurance jumps to cover the risk.

cards.name: The Maple Hollow Opera House
cards.flavor: The richest commission in years — the Mayor's pet project, half the council against it. Land the Opera House and you own the town's gratitude; let the bonds default and every shop pays for the scandal.

cards.name: The new County Hospital wing
cards.flavor: The county's been fighting over this wing for a decade. Deliver it and you're untouchable — miss the deadline and the county slaps an emergency levy on every business in town to cover the overrun.

cards.name: Performance reviews
cards.flavor: Sit-downs all round. Some of your crew shine and earn a bump, some need a talking-to — and a poor review is grounds to let someone go with cause.

cards.name: Union drive
cards.flavor: The trades organise. Nobody's easy to let go now — every firing is a fight you'll likely lose. Only a well-placed Favor can bust it.

cards.name: Service call
cards.flavor: A quick call comes in — your trade, in and out.

cards.name: Standard job
cards.flavor: A solid day’s work walks in the door.

cards.name: Tooled job
cards.flavor: Bigger than a hand-tool job — break out the basic gear.

cards.name: Pro job
cards.flavor: Serious work — youll want the pro rig and a real crew.

cards.name: Major job
cards.flavor: A major contract — full crew, both gear types, room to work.

cards.name: Marquee job
cards.flavor: The crown jewel — the biggest payday in town, if youve built for it.

cards.name: A job for another trade
cards.flavor: Walks in your door, but its not your trade — broker it and take a cut.

cards.name: A job for another trade
cards.flavor: Not your line of work — refer it to the shop that can, pocket the finders fee.

cards.name: A job for another trade
cards.flavor: Bigger than you can take — hand it off and skim the spread.

cards.name: Old Man Hettrick
cards.flavor: He wont pay a nickel he cant dispute — and hell be back next week. Net-90.

cards.name: Mrs. Lundgren
cards.flavor: Put her off and shell tell the whole church how slow you are. Net-90.

cards.name: Dots diner
cards.flavor: Do right by Dot and the good word brings work to your door.

cards.name: Chief Boon
cards.flavor: When the Chief calls, you go — drop everything and put someone on it.

cards.name: Insurance payout
cards.flavor: A claim from that ice-storm year finally clears the adjuster's desk.

flavor_by_season.Winter: This winter's storm damage check clears fast — the adjuster's seen it all before.

cards.name: Referral bonus
cards.flavor: Dot put in a good word at the diner counter, and the calls start coming.

cards.name: Old client settles up
cards.flavor: An old customer settles a long-forgotten invoice, sheepish about the delay.

cards.name: Tax refund
cards.flavor: The accountant found a deduction nobody else in the Hollow bothered to claim.

cards.name: Featured in the trade rag
cards.flavor: The County Trades Gazette runs your shop on the cover — the Pettigrews are livid.

cards.name: Win the county fair raffle
cards.flavor: Your booth wins a ribbon at the county fair — and the cash raffle to boot.

flavor_by_season.Fall: The autumn county fair is the big one — your booth takes the blue ribbon and the fat raffle purse.
flavor_by_season.Winter: The winter craft bazaar is sleepy, but you still walk off with the raffle pot.

cards.name: Equipment breakdown
cards.flavor: Your good compressor gives up the ghost — naturally, on a Friday afternoon.

flavor_by_season.Winter: The cold cracks a hydraulic line clean through — your good rig's down till the thaw.

cards.name: Surprise supplier invoice
cards.flavor: The supply house 'corrects' an old invoice — in their favor, of course.

flavor_by_season.Spring: April rains turn the jobsite to mud and wash out a day.
flavor_by_season.Summer: A sudden thunderstorm rolls over the Hollow and sends everyone home early.
flavor_by_season.Fall: An early cold snap stiffens the crew and slows everything down.
flavor_by_season.Winter: A blizzard buries Main Street; nobody's working today.

cards.name: Failed inspection
cards.flavor: The county inspector red-tags your panel — out of code, and the meter's running until a licensed electrician signs off.

cards.name: Safety write-up
cards.flavor: A safety walk-through turns up a stack of small violations — nothing's stopping, but everything's slower till you square it away.

cards.name: Took his holiday
cards.flavor: One of the crew's been promising the family a week at the lake all year — and now he's gone to take it.

cards.name: Down with a bug
cards.flavor: Something's going around the Hollow, and your best hand woke up flat on his back.

cards.name: On-the-job injury
cards.flavor: A ladder slips at the worst moment — nobody's badly hurt, but it's a workers' comp claim and a hand on the bench.

cards.name: Poached!
cards.flavor: The Pettigrews dangle a fat paycheck at one of your best — match it or lose them.

flavor_by_season.Fall: The Harvest Festival packs Main Street — your booth does a brisk trade.
flavor_by_season.Winter: The winter market is quieter, but the booth still turns a tidy profit.

flavor_by_season.Summer: A brutal heat wave bakes the Hollow — crews slow down and the AC bills pile up.
flavor_by_season.Spring: An early hot spell catches everyone off guard.

flavor_by_season.Winter: An ice storm glazes the county — downed lines, cancelled days, a cold snap of costs.
flavor_by_season.Fall: A freak early freeze coats everything in ice overnight.

cards.name: Storm of the decade
cards.flavor: The storm they'll talk about for years tears through Maple Hollow — everyone's reeling and scrambling.

flavor_by_season.Winter: The whole town slows for the holidays — a hand takes the week to be with family.

cards.name: Tool theft
cards.flavor: Someone helped themselves to your gear overnight. This is exactly what insurance is for.

cards.name: Mayor's re-election drive
cards.flavor: Mayor Crabtree's campaign passes the hat at the Grange hall — chip in and he'll remember it.

cards.name: Surprise inspection
cards.flavor: Inspector Grit turns up unannounced, clipboard out — and he's found something.

cards.name: Property reassessment
cards.flavor: Assessor Tolliver 'updates' your assessment — the new tax bill lands with a thud.

cards.name: Small-business grant
cards.flavor: Hal Ramsey at the Chamber comes through with a small-business grant — free money, for once.

cards.name: BBB Special
cards.flavor: The Better Business Bureau rolls a vendor fair into the Grange hall — the insurance man, the ad rep, the accountant, the trade-school booth. Stock up while they're in town.

cards.name: Burst main at the Grange Hall
cards.flavor: A water main lets go under the Grange hall — the town needs a plumber, today.

cards.name: Storm damage downtown
cards.flavor: The storm tore up Main Street — downed lines, ruined units, twisted signage. Every trade's got a piece.

cards.name: Breakdown at the Hollis Mill
cards.flavor: The old mill grinds to a halt — steel cracked, pipe split, machinery seized. The Hollises need it running by week's end.

cards.name: Trouble at Dot's Diner
cards.flavor: Dot's place goes dark mid-breakfast — the whole town will hear how fast (or slow) it gets fixed.

cards.name: File a patent
cards.flavor: You patent that jig you welded up — licensing checks roll in for every rig you run.

cards.name: Win an efficiency award
cards.flavor: The supplier names you 'Shop of the Quarter' — a little bonus for every tool on your floor.

cards.name: Depreciation audit
cards.flavor: The county reassesses your gear; every rig on the books gets its own little tax.

cards.name: Mandatory birthday party
cards.flavor: It's somebody's birthday every week; the crew chips in and, oddly, so do the vendors.

cards.name: Profit-sharing payout
cards.flavor: Payday's payday — the crew's profit-share comes due, a cut for every head on the roster.

cards.name: A tradesperson retires
cards.flavor: Old Vern hangs up his tool belt for good; you throw the party and break in the new kid.

cards.name: Vendor contract
cards.flavor: Your standing order at the lumber yard comes due — Svenson likes to be paid on time. Net-60.

cards.name: Supply-house credit
cards.flavor: The big supply house extends you net-90 — more to owe, but you hold the cash a good while. Float it if you dare.

cards.name: Equipment lease bill
cards.flavor: The equipment lease bill lands, stamped URGENT in red ink — due now.

cards.name: Networking lunch
cards.flavor: Lunch at the Grange hall with the Chamber of Commerce — you leave with a favor tucked in your pocket.
cards.text: Draw a Civil hand card (sabotage / rush / buy-time / slick lawyer) for later.

cards.name: Courthouse day
cards.flavor: The Hollow's little courthouse is in session, and somebody's name gets called.
cards.text: Draw and resolve a Civil event (audit, back taxes, a lawsuit, or — rarely — a Class Action).
